note: City of Huron campground in Memorial Park on the James River (10 Jersey Ave NE): 24 full-hookup RV sites in angled rows along the park road plus 49 tent sites, near the golf course, beach, mini-golf and paddle boats, with lake and river fishing access. RV Life mislabels it commercial - it is a city park. --Claude
summary: City page + imagery: 24 full-hookup sites (amps unstated) + 49 tent sites, $33 full hookup / $22 no hookup / $198 week, showers, dump, reserve by phone. Riverview KEPT after a hard look (path + brush fringe between stalls and river, ~35-40 m). Pin fine. pull_through left as stored (page silent).
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview KEPT. The RV stalls (angled rows in two gravel lots, ~44.3657,-98.1990 to ~44.3668,-98.1965) face the James River (a ~120 m wide pool above the Memorial Park dam, so river, not creek) across a grass strip, a paved riverside path and a continuous brush/tree fringe on the bank; water edge ~35-40 m away. Path + fringe between = a view value, not riverfront.
